question: Which classes of semi-divine beings appear within the scope of the revealed vision?
premises: Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas are included.
The list extends the cosmic vision.
inference: The revealed vision includes Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas.
plain_english: Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas, O beloved.
